fullPassage: Social media has altered business, politics, and friendships, making going viral a household term. The global financial industry links every bank and countless households in every country, making us vulnerable to human error taking place on the other side of the world. As Columbia University strategy professor Rita McGrath explains, years ago most of our institutions were separate and thereby buffered from the effects of errors outside their walls. That is no longer the case. The digitization of massive amounts of information has continued to grow enormously as the cost of computing power has decreased. The development of smart systems that communicate autonomously gave rise to an infinite variety of potential breakdowns. This interdependence is a breeding ground for complex failure. As Rita puts it, when “things that used to be kept separate bump up against each other, it becomes far more difficult to predict what’s going to happen next.” Information technology creates new vulnerabilities because interconnectedness instantly spreads the impact of small failures.

det.tip: term: 용어/말(household term), 학기(school term), 기간(term of office)

det.analysis:

questions.passage: The global financial industry links every bank and countless households in every country, making us vulnerable to human error __________ (take) place on the other side of the world.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (영어로) 쓰시오. (1단어)

det.analysis: human error ___ place는 '~에서 일어나고 있는 인적 오류'라는 뜻으로, 앞의 명사 human error를 꾸며 주는 현재분사가 필요해요. take place(일어나다)의 현재분사는 taking이므로 taking이 맞아요.
det.tip: 명사를 뒤에서 꾸미는 분사: 능동·진행이면 현재분사(-ing). error taking place = 일어나고 있는 오류

questions.passage: As Columbia University strategy professor Rita McGrath explains, years ago most of our institutions were separate and thereby __________ (buffer) from the effects of errors outside their walls.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (영어로) 쓰시오. (1단어)

det.analysis: were separate and thereby ___ from ... 구조에서 기관들이 외부 오류의 영향으로부터 '보호받은' 것이므로 수동태(be동사 were + 과거분사)가 필요해요. buffer(보호하다, 완충하다)의 과거분사는 buffered이므로 buffered가 맞아요.
det.tip: 수동태 be + p.p.: were buffered from = ~로부터 보호받았다

questions.passage: Social media has altered business, politics, and friendships, making going viral a household term. The global financial industry links every bank and countless households in every country, making us vulnerable to human error taking place on the other side of the world. As Columbia University strategy professor Rita McGrath explains, years ago most of our institutions were separate and thereby buffered from the effects of errors outside their walls. That is no longer the case. The digitization of massive amounts of information has continued to grow enormously as the cost of computing power has decreased. The development of smart systems that communicate autonomously gave rise to an infinite variety of potential breakdowns. This interdependence is a __________ for complex failure. As Rita puts it, when “things that used to be kept separate bump up against each other, it becomes far more difficult to predict what’s going to happen next.” Information technology creates new vulnerabilities because interconnectedness instantly spreads the impact of small failures.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① breeding ground(온상): 상호의존이 복잡한 실패를 '낳는 온상'이라는 문맥이에요 ← 정답
❌ ② safe haven(안전한 피난처): 실패를 낳는다는 부정적 흐름과 반대예요
❌ ③ dead end(막다른 길): 문맥과 무관해요
❌ ④ turning point(전환점): 문맥과 무관해요
det.tip: breeding ground for ~ = ~의 온상. 이어지는 complex failure가 단서예요.

det.analysis:
❌ ① natural disasters(자연재해): 금융 산업 연결과 직접 관련된 예시가 아니에요
✅ ② human error(인적 오류): 글로벌 금융이 전 세계에서 발생하는 '인적 오류'에 우리를 취약하게 만든다는 문맥이에요 ← 정답

❌ ④ political reform(정치 개혁): 문맥과 무관해요
